key_terms.كَفَلَ: To guarantee or act as surety for someone

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on detaining a guarantor if the guaranteed person is missing?
ai.summary: In this ruling from the Imam (peace be upon him), the guarantor is released from detention to locate the principal debtor, highlighting the distinction between personal suretyship (kafalah) and debt liability in Shia jurisprudence. This incident, recorded in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the practical application of releasing a guarantor when the primary obligation remains with the debtor, a principle widely cited by scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Tusi in legal discussions on conditional detention.
